name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_append_status_text_fmt
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::AppendStatusTextFmt formats a status string, trims one leading or trailing newline, appends it to the WOL status listbox, caps the tracked line count at 100, deletes the oldest item after the cap, and scrolls after nine entries.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke uses a real Windows LISTBOX provider for append/delete behavior; BN assembly evidence covers the exact LB_SETTOPINDEX scroll message because hidden test listboxes clamp presentation state.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x43d060 validates cdecl varargs layout, vsprintf into g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeStatusAppendBuffer char[1024], one leading newline trim with the single-newline empty-string case, one trailing newline trim, LB_ADDSTRING to m_statusList.m_hWnd, m_statusLineCount increment, LB_DELETESTRING when the count exceeds 100, and LB_SETTOPINDEX with m_statusLineCount - 8 when the count exceeds 9.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_append_status_text_smoke uses a real LISTBOX window to verify formatted text appending with leading/trailing newline trim, the single-newline empty-string case, and 105 append calls retaining a 100-line tracked/listbox cap with oldest-item deletion.
